paper.title: MatterSim: A Deep Learning Atomistic Model Across Elements, Temperatures and Pressures

result.summary: MatterSim 是一个基于深度图神经网络、主动学习和大规模第一性原理计算训练的原子尺度模型，旨在跨元素、温度和压力条件下高效预测材料性质 [S1.p3][S3.p1]。它作为零样本机器学习力场，在覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 的 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的能量 MAE，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。模型还能以接近第一性原理的精度计算晶格动力学、力学和热力学性质，例如与实验相比在 1000 K 以下对 Gibbs 自由能达到 15 meV/atom 的分辨率 [abstract]。此外，MatterSim 可作为持续学习和定制化平台，通过微调以最多减少 97% 的数据需求完成特定任务 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有材料性质预测模型主要基于近平衡晶体结构数据库，难以覆盖实际合成和工作条件下由温度和压力带来的巨大构型空间，从而限制了其在材料设计中的适用性 [S1.p2]。作者指出，候选材料的性质不仅取决于化学组成和近平衡原子结构，还取决于温度和压力等热力学条件 [S1.p2]。因此需要一种能在广阔化学、温度和压力空间内保持高预测精度的模型 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: However, the property of a potential candidate material not only depends on its chemical composition and corresponding near-equilibrium atomic structure, but also on thermodynamic conditions including temperature and pressure.

This results in a requirement of high predictive accuracy over an enormous configuration space well beyond the ground states or local minima of crystal structures typically captured by current databases and models, which fundamentally limits their applicability for materials design.

method.text: MatterSim 采用主动学习框架，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。第一性原理监督器在 GGA-PBE 水平（对特定材料加 Hubbard U 修正）提供能量、力和应力标签，训练后的模型作为代理引导探索器采样高不确定性区域，形成主动学习循环 [S2.SS1.p1]。模型骨干采用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种架构，其中 Graphormer 被加入了平移不变性、周期性边界条件和显式等变特征等修改 [S2.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor

the first-principles supervisor offers the deep learning model supervision signals relating to energies, forces, and stresses on the given structures at the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) level of theory with Hubbard U correction for select materials
we opt to use two primary architectures, M3GNet and Graphormer as the backbones for MatterSim
we baked in several additional attributes including invariance to translation and periodic boundary conditions and explicit equivariant features to better accommodate materials-related tasks

experiments.text: 训练数据集包含约 1700 万个第一性原理标注结构，覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 的温度压力范围 [S2.SS1.p2]。零样本性能在多个数据集上评测，包括 MPtrj-1k、Alexandria-1k、MPtrj-highest-stress-1k，以及为有限温度和压力条件创建的 MPF-Alkali-TP、MPF-TP 和 Random-TP [S6.p1][S6.p2]。此外还在 MatBench Discovery 的 IS2RE 任务、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质、自由能和相图、分子动力学以及 MatBench 的多个结构到性质回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: As of the date of publication, the training dataset contains $\sim$ 17M structures labeled with first-principles computations.
the curated dataset is representative of materials at temperatures and pressures covering 0– $5000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ and 0– $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$
MPtrj-1k and Alexandria-1k are collected by sampling randomly one thousand materials from the MPtrj and Alexandria dataset, respectively.

The MPF-Alkali-TP, MPF-TP, Random-TP benchmark sets are created with increasing complexity to evaluate the models’ performance on materials under finite temperature and pressure conditions with far from equilibrium atomic positions.

MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery

Fig. 4 (a) shows the benchmark results on the materials from the PhononDB, using maximum phonon frequency as an indicator, and a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$.

Fig. 4 (c) shows the parity plot of the $0\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ -bulk modulus predicted from MatterSim and their first-principles references. A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.

when compared with experimental measurements on over 200 materials as shown in Fig. S22, it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$
we randomly selected 118 systems including bulk inorganic materials, metal organic frameworks, two-dimensional materials, interfaces, molecular crystals, polymers and surfaces

MatterSim’s capability to directly predict materials properties from structures is benchmarked on a few regression tasks from MatBench, including prediction of computed band gaps, shear moduli, dielectric constants, max phonon frequency of bulk crystalline materials, and the exfoliation energies of two-dimensional materials.

findings.text: MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的能量 MAE，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。在 MatBench Discovery 上取得 F1 分数 0.83 和 25 meV/atom 的形成能 MAE [S2.SS2.p2]。声子最大频率 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。与实验相比，Gibbs 自由能在 1000 K 以下达到 15 meV/atom 的 MAE，优于专门在实验数据上训练的模型 [S2.SS2.p5]。在 118 个系统上，MatterSim 在 0–5000 K 加热和 0–1000 GPa 压缩下均取得超过 90% 的分子动力学成功率 [S2.SS2.p6]。通过微调，仅需 30 个构型即可达到从头训练 900 个构型的性能，数据效率提升 30 倍 [S2.SS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36 meV/atom (43 meV/atom as chemical accuracy) on MPF-TP
marking a ten-fold increase in accuracy compared with previous efforts

with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$
A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.

it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ (see Section S11.1), lower than dedicated models directly trained on experimental data
MatterSim achieved more than 90% success rate for all the material families tested, exhibiting robustness over wide temperature ranges.

with only 30 configurations sampled from an ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectory with rev-PBE0-D3 level of theory, MatterSim can be efficiently fine-tuned and the resultant model (indicated as finetune-30 model) reaches the same performance as the model trained from scratch with all 900 configurations

limitations.text: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前使用半局域原子相互作用描述，长程相互作用主要依赖消息传递或注意力权重更新，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相系统）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。数据覆盖方面，当前模型仅在同质体相系统上训练，未显式包含对催化等应用至关重要的表面和界面数据 [S3.p3]。此外，模型目前仅原生支持 DFT-PBE 水平的推理，限制了其在涉及复杂相互作用（如聚合物和有机液体）系统中的应用 [S3.p3]。模型目前仅支持能量、力和应力的原生预测，纳入电荷、自旋、磁矩等更多数据模态可能进一步提升精度和适用性 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: it currently utilizes a semi-local description of atomic interactions, where long-range interactions majorly leverages message passing or updates on attention weights through graph nodes
it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
the current model is trained only on homogeneous bulk systems, without explicit inclusion of surface and interface data that are crucial for applications such as catalysis
the model currently only naively supports inferences with DFT-PBE level of theory, limiting its use for systems involving complex interactions, such as polymers and organic liquids
Currently, the model only supports the native prediction of energy, forces, and stresses.
